scripts.check: deno fmt --check --ignore=node_modules,dist . ../preload ../ipc && deno lint --ignore=node_modules,dist . ../preload ../ipc && tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test --test-reporter=spec 'desktop/*_test.ts' 'app-frame/**/*_test.ts' 'workspace/*_test.ts' 'terminal/*_test.ts' 'editor/*_test.ts' 'build_test.ts' && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-reporter=spec '../../../e2e/shell/terminal_test.ts' && deno check --config=desktop/core/deno.json desktop/main.ts desktop/core/allowlist.ts desktop/core/client.ts desktop/core/connection.ts desktop/core/events.ts desktop/core/node-io.ts desktop/core/routes.ts desktop/core/supervise.ts && deno test --allow-all --config=desktop/core/deno.json desktop/core/ confirmation/
scripts.precheck: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const dir=path.resolve('..','node_modules'); fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); const link=path.join(dir,'zod'); try{fs.symlinkSync(path.resolve('node_modules/zod'), link)}catch(e){if(e.code!=='EEXIST') throw e}"
